mapper.select: select si.serve_type_id, si.name, si.update_time, s.sale_status, s.serve_item_id, si.reference_price, si.create_time, s.region_id, s.price, s.id, s.is_hot, st.name serve_type_name FROM serve s INNER JOIN serve_item si on si.id = s.serve_item_id INNER JOIN serve_type st on st.id = si.serve_type_id WHERE s.region_id = #{regionId}
